section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1993
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1993 N.C.R.B.- 17 1.3.6 Statistics on number of vehicles, accidents, share of vehicles per thousand population etc. of other countries are available only upto the year 1992. In the absence of availability of all parameters uniformly for all the countries, an indepth study of the conditions can not be made. However, the comparative data of the following 12 countries show that India has the lowest share of 27 vehicles per thousand persons as against 631 in Japan. In the case of rate of accidents per thousand vehicles, our country ranked third highest (11.7) after Hongkong (32.5) and Singapore (13.6).
